name: Camping Riffler
beschreibung: The **Camping Riffler** is located in the district of **Perjen** in **Landeck** in **Tiroler Oberland**, just outside the confluence of the **Sanna** into the **Inn**. This **year-round campsite** offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents across multiple terrace levels. Facilities include a sanitary block with free showers, a waste disposal and supply station, as well as a small shop for essentials. The site provides direct access to the **Via Claudia Augusta cycling route**, connecting seamlessly to the regional cycling network. Guests can reach **Landeck-Zams train station** on foot, making the campsite well-suited for arrivals by public transport. Nearby hiking and skiing areas like **Venet** or **Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis** are just a short drive away.
